title: Parametrize Python test_vectors.py with vector filenames
description: In python/tests/test_vectors.py, replace loop-over-files with pytest.mark.parametrize using vector filename as test ID. Each vector file becomes a separate test case: FAILED test_vectors[ccp13] instead of a generic line number. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_vectors.py -v (should show individual vector names)
